migration_summary: Additive nullable column with no backfill and no constraint validation—low lock risk, metadata-only change on a busy table.
migration_sql: ALTER TABLE task_instance ADD COLUMN note TEXT;
schema_summary: Representative low-risk Airflow-style additive DDL (nullable text column).
risk_narrative: Nullable ADD COLUMN without DEFAULT rewrite is typically a short catalog operation on PostgreSQL. No full-table rewrite, no NOT NULL scan, no index build. Rollback is a simple DROP COLUMN if the column is unused.
lessons_learned: Prefer nullable additive columns as the expand step before backfills or NOT NULL enforcement. Keep high-risk work (backfill, constraints, indexes) in later migrations so each step has a clear downgrade.
surprise_notes: Low risk does not mean zero time on enormous catalogs, but blast radius is orders of magnitude smaller than STORED generated columns or blocking indexes.
